info.name: Gainsight CS User Management SCIM API
info.description:
The User Management API provides endpoints for managing Gainsight users, company team records, and includes SCIM support for automated user provisioning and de-provisioning through identity providers.

Contact Support:
 Name: Gainsight Support
 Email: support@gainsight.com
